name: Drone Pilot
promptTemplate: You are flying a small quadcopter drone through a green hoop. Slate-grey towers reach the ceiling: fly around them. Coloured blocks are low: climb over them or go around. The hoop floats at its own height, so match its altitude. Camera view, looking forward and slightly down: {{frame}}. Your recent moves, oldest first: {{history}}. Reply with exactly one word: FORWARD, TURN_LEFT, TURN_RIGHT, ASCEND, DESCEND or STOP.
